newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metsa-Botnia to hike pulp price to $580/t.
newsitem.headline: Metsa-Botnia to hike pulp price to $580/t.

text.p: Finnish pulp producer Metsa-Botnia Oy Ab, owned by forest industry groups UPM-Kymmene Oy and Metsa-Serla Oy, said on Tuesday it would raise its long-fibre pulp price to $580 a tonne from $520 at the start of May.
"We have decided to raise pulp prices in the beginning of May," Jyrki Yrjo-Koskinen, marketing director at Metsa-Botnia, told Reuters by telephone.
Metsa-Botnia said it would also raise in May its price for totally chlorine free (TCF) short-fibre pulp to 460 ecu per tonne from 410 ecu.
